question: Does connection with one's own body differentiate the living-liberated person?
premises: Connection with another body does not differentiate the liberated person.
The living-liberated person still has a connection with his own body.
The same non-differentiating principle applies to that own-body connection.
inference: For the living-liberated, even connection with one's own body does not create real differentiation.
plain_english: Just as connection with another body does not differentiate him, so too, even for the living-liberated, connection with his own body does not differentiate him.
